name: West Region
eyebrow: West Region · Jurong, Clementi and Tuas
title: West Region:
title_em: industry, universities and the port of the future.
tagline: Jurong, Clementi and Tuas: industry, NTU, the lakeside gardens and the new mega-port.
summary: The West Region is Singapore's industrial engine. Jurong Island is the petrochemical hub, Tuas is building a very large, highly automated port, and Jurong East is a regional business centre.
It is also a place of learning and green space: NTU's campus lies in the west, and Jurong Lake Gardens and the Chinese and Japanese Gardens are popular for a weekend walk.

sport.intro: Lion City Sailors play at Jurong East Stadium, and the lakeside parks are full of runners and cyclists.

community.intro: Singaporeans from the west often grew up near industry and technology, and many have taken that engineering mindset overseas.

ancestry: Tracing your family in Singapore? The National Archives of Singapore and the National Library Board hold oral histories, newspapers, maps and records, and many are searchable online.
